owner_request_scope: Owner requested candidate expansion, a uniform visual t-3 shift, recovery of the prior small-window/small-box/position-spread/negative-sampling method, and downstream 3060 training. The request authorizes preparation and training once the repository's sample-level Gold Dataset gates are satisfied; it does not make machine candidates into Owner-confirmed labels.

gold_dataset_gate.direction_blocker: Local Signal V2 currently freezes only the Owner-confirmed SHORT semantic. LONG mirror candidates remain mirror_unconfirmed and are neither positive nor negative.

timing_evidence.interpretation: A uniform t-3 review marker does not recover a verified per-sample core boundary.

recovered_training_contract.input_context: Shortest sufficient context, first round approximately 14-22 bars. The actual frozen R1/R2 baseline used dynamic W12-19.
recovered_training_contract.core_box: 4-7 bars; original Owner geometry or an Owner-approved geometry derivation only.
recovered_training_contract.confirmation: 3 bars preferred, 5 bars maximum after core; 6-10 bars excluded.
recovered_training_contract.box_position: Must vary naturally with shortest sufficient context; fixed-right, fixed-center and one global delta are forbidden.

prior_training_recipe.augmentation: HSV, flip, mosaic, mixup, cutmix, copy-paste and erasing disabled

position_spread_reference.warning: This historical position-spread artifact itself is training_eligible=false and its quality gate says not_first_round; counts are lineage evidence, not an approved target quota.

negative_dataset.reason: Safe easy/hard negative selection requires accepted positive classes and exact Owner-box exclusion zones. Creating negatives before those exist can label unconfirmed mirror shapes as negatives or place backgrounds near future gold boxes.
required_controls: full Owner-box exclusion zones take priority over the 3:1 soft ratio
easy and hard negatives tracked separately

rtx3060_environment_check.reproducibility_warning: scripts/train_on_3060.sh and scripts/windows/train_dense.py were not committed in the shared working tree during this run, so they were not adopted or committed by this experiment. Training remains blocked independently by the Gold Dataset gate.

required_to_unblock: Owner confirms whether this expansion is SHORT-only or explicitly approves LONG mirror semantics.
Owner provides per-sample keep/drop/uncertain verdicts; protocol approval alone is insufficient.
Accepted samples receive per-sample core geometry from original Owner boxes or an explicitly approved derivation.
A time/dependency split is frozen before images, labels or negatives are materialized.
Negative exclusions are built from the accepted gold geometry; the 3:1 ratio remains a soft target.
Owner explicitly approves the resulting dataset manifest as training_eligible.
The exact 3060 training entry and dependency contract are committed before launch.
